narration: This robot passed its open-arena test. Watch what happens when a pedestrian crosses.
title: A test is not a guarantee

narration: I built EmbodiWeave to answer two questions: which robot checkpoint should I retrain, and is the result safe to ship?
title: Which checkpoint? Safe to ship?

narration: Falkor-D-B connects policies, training runs, trials, evaluations, failures and decisions. The links preserve what produced what.
title: The history is a graph

narration: First, the agent queries failed validation suites, matching the exact artifact hash. A look-alike checkpoint cannot substitute for measured evidence.
title: Diagnose the exact artifact

narration: Matching tensor shapes are not enough. Falkor-D-B links sensor and action contracts, so incompatible starting points are excluded.
title: Same shape. Different meaning.

narration: The planner ranks eligible origins by failed suites and deficits. Before training, its decision records the Cypher, parameters and returned evidence in Falkor-D-B.
title: The decision is evidence too

narration: If Falkor-D-B is unavailable, planning stops. There is no silent fallback.
title: No graph. No plan.

narration: Longer training came first. A retained-task failure then led to rehearsal across training families. Each attempt added about three hundred thousand P-P-O steps.
title: Two measured training attempts

narration: The original passed one of four suites. Longer training passed three. Rehearsal passed all four. The collision limits stayed at ten, five, ten and fifteen percent.
title: Same gate. Every candidate.

narration: One held-out target test recorded thirteen collisions across one hundred episodes. The limit was ten percent. I report it anyway. Production stays unchanged.
title: I report it anyway.

narration: Finally, I transferred the same two-dimensional-trained checkpoints into MuJoCo physics. On forty fresh target episodes, the deployed policy collided 24 times. The rehearsal checkpoint collided 3 times. Crossing still had eight collisions. No retraining.
title: New physics. Unchanged checkpoints.

narration: The graph and checksummed evidence make these results inspectable. EmbodiWeave. Built on Falkor-D-B.
title: Robot training decisions you can audit.
